title: Sticker-TTS: Learn to Utilize Historical Experience with a Sticker-driven Test-Time Scaling Framework
authors_zh: Jie Chen、Jinhao Jiang、Yingqian Min、Zican Dong、Shijie Wang、Wayne Xin Zhao、Ji-Rong Wen（机构：中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、东北大学秦皇岛分校）
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展与历史经验感知的迭代推理框架
best_for_zh: 研究固定推理预算下如何复用既有推理尝试的读者。
one_line: Sticker-TTS turns previous reasoning traces into corrected compact cues that guide later test-time solution attempts.
Sticker-TTS 将先前推理轨迹压缩为可校正的关键线索，用以引导后续测试时解题。
why: It gives historical reasoning an explicit compact representation that can be corrected and reused instead of repeatedly sampling from scratch.
inclusion_reason: It reallocates inference computation across history-aware iterative refinement, using compact intermediate evidence rather than independent repeated samples.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Independent sampling is a simple way to spend more inference computation on difficult reasoning problems, but it often produces many similar chains of thought. Earlier attempts can contain a correct sub-result, a useful constraint, or the precise place where an approach failed, yet ordinary sampling discards that experience and asks the model to begin again. Passing an entire long history into the next prompt is not a clean solution either: salient facts can be buried in verbose traces, while a bare final answer gives too little material for revision.

The paper asks how a reasoning system can make accumulated attempts useful without making every later round read an uncontrolled transcript. Its target is a repeatable inference loop in which a compact record of conditions, strategies, and detected mistakes transfers information from one attempt to the next, so additional computation is directed toward correcting or extending prior work rather than generating unrelated repetitions.

独立采样是把更多推理计算投入困难问题的一种直接方式，但它常常产生许多相近的思维链。先前尝试中可能已有正确的中间结论、有用的约束条件，或恰好揭示了某条路径失败的位置；普通采样却会丢弃这些经验，让模型重新开始。把完整的长历史直接放入下一轮提示也并非理想解法：重要事实会淹没在冗长轨迹中，而只有一个最终答案又不足以支撑修订。

论文研究推理系统怎样既利用累计尝试，又不让后续每一轮都读取失控的完整记录。它追求一种可重复的推理时循环：将条件、策略和已发现错误压缩为紧凑记录，在多次尝试之间传递信息，使新增计算用于修正或扩展已有工作，而不是生成彼此无关的重复答案。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Sticker-TTS represents an earlier solution attempt through a short structured object called a sticker. Rather than retaining the whole trace as undifferentiated context, an extractor summarizes key reasoning steps and global strategy into conditions and a question summary. A separate modifier then inspects that object for computational or methodological errors, so the next attempt receives a revised cue rather than an unexamined memory.

The central design is a division of labor among three language-model roles: extraction preserves the important content, modification tests and repairs it, and utilization combines the repaired sticker with the question and previous answer to write a new trace. A sticker is therefore neither a mere answer nor a passive summary. It is an editable intermediate representation that makes historical experience operational in the choice of the next reasoning path.

Sticker-TTS 用一种称为贴纸的短结构化对象表示较早的解题尝试。它不把整条轨迹作为未经区分的上下文保留下来，而是由提取器将关键推理步骤和整体策略概括为条件与问题摘要。随后，独立的修改器检查该对象中是否存在计算或方法错误，使下一次尝试接收的是经修订的线索，而非未经审查的记忆。

其核心设计是将工作分给三种语言模型角色：提取负责保留重要内容，修改负责检验并修复内容，使用负责把修复后的贴纸同问题和前一答案结合，写出新的轨迹。因此，贴纸既不是一个普通答案，也不是被动摘要；它是一种可编辑的中间表示，使历史经验能够实际影响下一条推理路径的选择。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inference begins with the utilizer answering the question once without a sticker. At each following iteration, the extractor receives the preceding trace and question and produces a structured sticker; the modifier checks it and emits a corrected version; the utilizer then receives the corrected sticker, original question, and preceding answer to produce a new trace and answer. After the fixed number of iterations, the system aggregates the collected answers by majority vote. The record passed across rounds is therefore trace → sticker → revised sticker → new trace, rather than a growing raw transcript alone.

The authors initialize all three roles with distillation. They use solvable OpenThoughts mathematics problems, DeepSeek-R1 traces, and o3-mini-produced stickers to construct role-specific examples; for modifier and utilizer training, they simulate correction cases and retain only trajectories whose final reasoning is completely correct. A subsequent self-improvement stage lets the initialized framework generate iterative trajectories, then filters them for solution validity and correction significance before further fine-tuning. The paper reports roughly one thousand distilled examples for the initial stage and controls the retained error-to-correct versus correct-to-correct transitions at a one-to-two ratio in the later data.

推理先由使用器在没有贴纸的情况下回答一次问题。之后每一轮中，提取器读取上一条轨迹和问题，生成结构化贴纸；修改器检查该贴纸并输出修订版；使用器再接收修订贴纸、原问题和上一答案，生成新的轨迹与答案。达到设定迭代次数后，系统以多数投票汇总所收集的答案。因此，跨轮传递的记录是“轨迹—贴纸—修订贴纸—新轨迹”，而非只让原始长文本不断累积。

作者先以蒸馏初始化三种角色。他们使用可解的 OpenThoughts 数学题、DeepSeek-R1 轨迹以及 o3-mini 生成的贴纸构造分角色样本；训练修改器和使用器时模拟纠错情形，只保留最终推理完全正确的轨迹。随后，自我改进阶段让初始化后的框架生成迭代轨迹，再根据解答有效性和纠错显著性进行过滤，并继续微调。论文报告初始阶段约有一千个蒸馏样本，后续数据中保留的“由错改对”与“由对改对”转变比例控制为一比二。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper evaluates the framework on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and OlymMATH, comparing it with self-consistency, parallel and early-exit variants, and reported reinforcement-learning reasoning systems under comparable inference budgets. With a 7B model, the introduction reports a 12.42% relative improvement over self-consistency on AIME 2025; it also reports a 9.79% relative improvement over Skywork-OR1 on OlymMATH and an 18.75% relative improvement over Light-R1 on AIME 2025 in the stated multi-round comparison.

The paper makes the cost claim concrete by counting generated long chain-of-thought solutions: its N iterations cost about as much as 2N long solutions because the extractor output is short, while the modifier and utilizer are the main long-generation components. At N=10, it reports a cost comparable to Cons@20 and says this setting outperforms most reported baseline Cons@64 results. Ablations remove the extractor, modifier, or both and reduce the reported AIME Cons@20 scores, which supports the claim that compression and correction each contribute rather than the gains coming only from repeated sampling.

官方论文在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 OlymMATH 上评测该框架，并在可比推理预算下与自一致性、并行和早停变体，以及文中报告的强化学习推理系统比较。引言报告：使用七十亿参数模型时，它在 AIME 2025 上相较自一致性取得 12.42% 的相对提升；在 OlymMATH 上相较 Skywork-OR1 提升 9.79%；在论文所述的多轮比较中，在 AIME 2025 上相较 Light-R1 提升 18.75%。

论文通过统计生成的长思维链数量，使成本主张更具体：由于提取器输出很短，而修改器和使用器才是主要的长文本生成部分，进行 N 轮的成本约等于生成 2N 条长解答。它报告 N=10 的成本与 Cons@20 大致相当，并称该设置优于多数已报告的 Cons@64 基线结果。消融实验分别移除提取器、修改器或两者，都会降低报告的 AIME Cons@20 分数，因而支持压缩和纠错都在发挥作用，而非收益仅仅来自重复采样的结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is not simply using one model to critique another or iterating on an answer. Sticker-TTS assigns historical reasoning a deliberately bounded, structured representation between full trajectories and final answers. That representation contains the conditions and strategy judged worth carrying forward, then becomes an object of explicit error correction before it steers the next computation. This directly addresses the information-management problem created by long multi-round histories.

It also couples this inference design to a tailored training recipe. The three role-specific models are first taught through distilled examples and then improved using their own filtered iterative trajectories, including both repaired failures and valid refinements. Compared with independent best-of-N sampling, the system's added computation is sequentially dependent: later tokens are spent after examining a compact account of what earlier computation established or got wrong. This makes it a concrete proposal for progressive, history-aware allocation of test-time budget.

新意不只是让一个模型批评另一个模型，或对答案进行迭代。Sticker-TTS 为历史推理设置了介于完整轨迹和最终答案之间、边界明确的结构化表示。该表示保留被认为值得传递的条件与策略，然后在引导下一次计算前成为显式纠错对象。这直接回应了长而多轮的历史记录带来的信息管理难题。

它还将这种推理设计与专门的训练方案结合起来。三种分角色模型先通过蒸馏样本学习，再使用自身经过过滤的迭代轨迹改进，其中同时包含修复失败的样本和原本正确但继续优化的样本。与相互独立的最佳 N 次采样相比，系统新增的计算存在顺序依赖：后续生成会先检查对早先计算已得到或做错之处的紧凑说明，再决定如何投入令牌。因此，它为测试时预算的渐进式、历史感知分配提出了具体方案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach requires three specialized model calls per refinement round and still relies on long reasoning generation in the modifier and utilizer, so practical latency, serving cost, and orchestration failures may matter even when the long-solution count is favorable. A corrupted sticker can carry a wrong abstraction or correction into later rounds, and majority voting among sequentially related answers may overstate the amount of independent evidence. The reported results are concentrated on exact-answer mathematics, while the calibration of stickers, the stopping rule, and the value of history reuse remain to be established for open-ended, tool-mediated, or non-verifiable tasks.

该方法在每个修订轮次都需要三次分工明确的模型调用，修改器和使用器仍依赖长推理生成；因此，即使长解答数量的比较有利，实际延迟、服务成本和编排失败仍可能很重要。错误的贴纸可能把错误抽象或错误修正带入后续轮次，而在顺序相关的多个答案间做多数投票，也可能高估独立证据的数量。报告结果主要集中于答案可精确判定的数学任务；贴纸的校准、停止规则以及历史复用的价值是否适用于开放式、工具参与或不可验证任务，仍有待确立。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Sticker-TTS is useful when a reasoning service can afford several sequential attempts but wants each new attempt to react to earlier evidence rather than restart independently. A practical implementation should log the question, every trace and answer, extracted and revised stickers, role prompts, iteration count, token and wall-clock cost, and final aggregation. Those records make it possible to test whether a gain comes from genuine correction, merely more generated text, or a particular role prompt; they also support replacing individual roles with smaller or stronger models while preserving the same history interface.
当推理服务能够承担若干次顺序尝试，却希望每一次新尝试都回应先前证据而非独立重启时，Sticker-TTS 很有用。实际实现应记录问题、每条轨迹与答案、提取和修订后的贴纸、各角色提示、迭代次数、令牌与实际时间成本，以及最终聚合结果。这些记录能够检验收益究竟来自真正的纠错、仅仅来自生成了更多文本，还是来自某个特定的角色提示；它们也支持在保持相同历史接口的前提下，用更小或更强的模型替换某一角色。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: When reading or reproducing the work, inspect the sticker schema and prompts before focusing on headline accuracy. Check how an extractor distinguishes an indispensable condition from decorative reasoning, how the modifier is prevented from confidently inventing a correction, and how much of the improvement survives when the same total tokens are allocated to independent samples. The most informative replication reports per-round answer accuracy, sticker factuality, transition type, total generated tokens, latency, and the correlation among final candidate answers. It should also separate improvements from the two-stage training recipe from improvements caused by the recursive inference loop itself.
阅读或复现实验时，应先检查贴纸的结构和提示，再关注总体准确率。需要考察提取器怎样区分不可缺少的条件与装饰性推理，修改器怎样避免自信地虚构修正，以及在相同总令牌被分配给独立样本时，收益还能保留多少。最有信息量的复现应报告每轮答案准确率、贴纸事实性、转变类型、总生成令牌、延迟以及最终候选答案之间的相关性；还应区分两阶段训练方案带来的提升和递归推理循环本身带来的提升。
